executionWakeBridge.note: This board can detect and publish triggers without Claude, but it cannot itself wake Claude or place Robinhood orders.

watchlist.armingRule: A confirmed buy must be added to execution-watchlist.json before this monitor can protect its saved exit levels.

triggerDefinitions.BUY_TRIGGER: Qualified fresh entry zone reached; live broker checks still required.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_1_STOP: Stop/invalidation reached — verify position and sell protected quantity.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_2_TARGET1: Target 1 reached — execute validated first scale-out.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_3_TARGET2: Target 2 reached — execute validated exit/runner decision.

creditPolicy: Alpaca/GitHub monitor prices. Claude should read this small trigger board first and avoid market/broker work when executionNeeded=false.
